quality.note: Delta = (1 - 8x^3)^2 verified; key right. Five statements on a 3x3 expansion is heavy for 72 s; (A)/(B) mutually exclusive pair. Below paper polish.
Delta = 64x^6 - 16x^3 + 1 = (1 - 8x^3)^2; a = -8, b = 2, x = 1/2 double root, Delta >= 0. Correct, but heavy for 72 seconds.

fit.note: Full 3x3 expansion plus root analysis across five statements: about 131 s, above typical level.
